svg.title: Kingman's formula
svg.desc: Charges flow into a fraud scorer that takes 10 ms each. As traffic climbs from 60 to 80, 95 and 99 a second, the scorer goes from 60% to 99% busy. The wait follows Kingman's formula, busy over idle times 10 ms: 15 ms, 40 ms, 190 ms, then almost a second, and the line grows from about 1 to 3, 18 and 98 waiting.
svg.text: Same 10 ms worker. At 80% busy jobs wait 40 ms, at 95% they wait 190 ms.
